intent: Standardize and clean iKant_EDU repository, software and product using CORA as a source-assurance method; preserve original owners, minimize added machinery, and require independently observed outcomes.

domains.name: REPOSITORY
domains.minimal_action: Classify committed files and workflow roles with BASE/HEAD/TREE/blob; nominate one bounded redundancy only after literal, dynamic and external consumers are investigated.
domains.falsifier: Unregistered change, unresolved consumer or inferred workflow equivalence blocks removal; a renamed file is not evidence of a safe deletion.

domains.name: SOFTWARE
domains.minimal_action: Select the smallest reversible Node/OneShell call-path correction, keep original owner identity, run existing Node tests plus explicit negative physical readbacks, then invalidate changed witnesses.
domains.falsifier: A green synthetic model, source SHA or CI step cannot substitute for owner-bound runtime behavior or complete dynamic call-path coverage.

domains.name: PRODUCT
domains.minimal_action: Evaluate a real new-session ORIENTATION to I ACCEPT to EDU to C135/C87/C125-S03 six-slot delivery, then independently measure task success and user comprehension.
domains.falsifier: Missing field receipt, installed-prompt readback, independent review or user holdout blocks PRODUCT_GO even with every repository and CI check green.
